captions.detailed: This 3D model features an urban commuter bicycle front fork assembly with an integrated low-rider rack and a flat platform. It includes a threaded steerer tube, a retro quill stem holding riser handlebars with black grips, and straight fork blades terminating in box-style dropouts. The front rack is constructed from thin black tubing and supports a square, flat black platform on vertical standoffs. The frame-mounting section is rendered in light grey, while the fork, rack, and handlebars are finished in a dark matte black.
captions.instruction: Create a CadQuery model of an urban commuter bicycle fork featuring a threaded steerer, a quill stem with riser handlebars, and a front-mounted low-rider rack supporting a flat platform. The assembly should have a light grey headtube section and a dark black finish on the fork blades, handlebars, and rack.
captions.factory: The code constructs the assembly by modeling individual components using basic primitives. The fork blades and rack tubing are built using cylinders and sweeps along defined wire paths, combined with boolean operations for the joints. The flat platform is a thin box primitive, and the handlebars are swept profiles with cylindrical grips. The parts are organized into a multi-body assembly with defined spatial origins and rotational joints representing the steering axis.
